items.title: Log Intrusion Hunt (Hands-On Lab)
items.description: Engine-driven SOC lab: hunt an SSH brute-force → web shell → lateral movement → exfil intrusion through real logs in a live terminal.

items.title: SIEM Alert Triage (Hands-On Lab)
items.description: Engine-driven SOC lab: triage live SIEM/IDS/netflow alerts and separate real C2 beaconing from false positives.

items.title: System Hardening Audit (Hands-On Lab)
items.description: Engine-driven lab: audit sshd, TLS, sudoers, and exposed ports for misconfigurations in a real terminal.

items.title: Vulnerability Scan Triage (Hands-On Lab)
items.description: Engine-driven lab: prioritize a vulnerability scan by CVSS, internet exposure, and exploitability; spot the false positive.

items.title: Breach Response Capstone (Full IR Lab)
items.description: Capstone IR lab: work a full Log4Shell breach end-to-end across logs, firewall, IDS, and monitoring.

items.title: Governance Document Classification (Hands-On Lab)
items.description: Engine-driven GRC lab: classify governance documents (policy, standard, procedure, guideline, SLA, NDA) from their content.

items.title: Quantitative Risk Analysis (Hands-On Lab)
items.description: Engine-driven lab: compute SLE, ALE, and safeguard ROI for quantitative risk analysis (SY0-701 Domain 5).

items.title: Risk Register Analysis (Hands-On Lab)
items.description: Engine-driven lab: score a qualitative risk register (likelihood × impact), apply risk appetite, and choose treatments.

items.title: Vendor Risk Assessment (Hands-On Lab)
items.description: Engine-driven third-party risk lab: assess a vendor via SOC 2 report, MSA, and questionnaire; find the missing control.

items.title: PBQ: Firewall Ruleset Configuration
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: configure an ordered DMZ firewall ACL (least privilege, explicit deny).

items.title: PBQ: Security Control Classification
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: classify controls by type (technical/managerial/operational/physical) and function (preventive/detective/corrective).

items.title: PBQ: Attack Identification
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: identify attacks (SQLi, phishing, DDoS, XSS, ARP poisoning, privilege escalation) from realistic evidence.

items.title: PBQ: Malware Identification
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: identify the malware type (ransomware, worm, trojan, RAT, rootkit, keylogger, logic bomb, spyware) from EDR and forensic evidence.

items.title: PBQ: Social Engineering & Network Attacks
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: identify the social-engineering or network technique (vishing, smishing, spear phishing, whaling, BEC, watering hole, typosquatting, pharming) from real artifacts.

items.title: PBQ: Threat Actor Attribution
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: attribute the threat actor (nation-state/APT, organized crime, hacktivist, insider, script kiddie, shadow IT, competitor) from intelligence briefs.

items.title: PBQ: Change Management
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: classify change-request artifacts by element (impact analysis, backout plan, maintenance window, CAB approval, test results, stakeholder notification, version control, SOP).

items.title: PBQ: Governance & Asset Management
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: classify governance documents (policy/standard/procedure/guideline), data roles (owner/custodian/processor), and asset sanitization.

items.title: PBQ: Identity & Access (AAA)
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: classify AAA pillars (authentication/authorization/accounting) and authentication factors (something you know/have/are/somewhere/do).

items.title: PBQ: Secure Design & Zero Trust
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: classify Zero Trust components (policy engine, PEP, adaptive identity) and secure-design principles (defense in depth, least privilege, separation of duties, deception, fail-secure).

items.title: PBQ: PKI & Certificate Troubleshooting
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: diagnose TLS/certificate failures from openssl and browser errors (expired, untrusted root, name mismatch, revoked, broken chain, weak algorithm, not-yet-valid, wrong key usage).

items.title: PBQ: Cryptographic Solution Selection
items.description: Security+ performance-based question: select the correct cryptographic primitive (TLS, AES, RSA, SHA, Diffie-Hellman, PKI) per scenario.
